title: Chef Steve
description: Steve has become a chef, and now he can craft over 38 new foods.
body:
![Chef Steve Creative Tab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a9e4d66bd532c726a5aae532142cb192d3a1052.png)

Chef Steve expands Minecraft's food variety with 30+ new items — jams, breads, skewers, pizzas, stews, cakes, and more. From roasted veggies to hearty soups, enjoy a richer culinary experience using ingredients you already know and love!
